title: CSV, TSV, and pipe export with one quoting algorithm
task: Export a slice of `Transaction{ID, Memo string; Cents int}` as CSV, TSV, and pipe-delimited text via `CSV(ts)`, `TSV(ts)`, and `Pipe(ts)` in package `export`. In all three the first row is a header, and any field containing the delimiter, a double quote, or a newline is wrapped in double quotes with inner quotes doubled. Same algorithm, three delimiters.
